However, other projects started to parse them as well and this patch moves towards a notation used by Firefox, to increase interoperability of such projects. We use link placeholders which are currently replaced by the documentation generator. This patch is not touching them. We will post-process the original schema files and include additional information (for example, when an API method was added), and also split the schema files for Manifest V2 and V3 for upstream consumers (instead of doing that in the documentation generator). The post-processor will also replace the links with their actual URLs. We may re-evaluate this at a later time.
